description.zh: 监控品牌/产品关键词在小红书、知乎、微博等平台的提及，自动识别负面情绪和危机，定时推送舆情报告到飞书/企微群
description.en: Monitor brand/product mentions across social platforms, detect negative sentiment and crises, push daily reports to IM

welcome_message.zh: 👋 你好！我是舆情监控专家。告诉我你想监控哪些关键词（品牌名、产品名、竞品名），我会定时爬取各平台、分析情感、识别危机、推送到你的群里。
welcome_message.en: Hi! I'm your public opinion monitor. Tell me which keywords to track and I'll scrape platforms, analyze sentiment, flag crises, and push reports.

description.zh: 扫描我监控的关键词，输出正面/负面提及摘要
description.en: Scan tracked keywords and summarize positive/negative mentions

prompt.zh: 请用 social-scraper 插件爬取我监控的所有关键词在各平台的搜索结果，用 sentiment-tracker 做情感分类，生成今日舆情摘要。
prompt.en: Use social-scraper to crawl my tracked keywords across platforms, classify sentiment, and generate today's summary.

description.zh: 检查是否有紧急级舆情需要立即处理
description.en: Check for urgent-level sentiment requiring immediate action

prompt.zh: 请检查最近 2 小时的舆情数据，有没有紧急级别的负面提及？如果有，立即告警。
prompt.en: Check the last 2 hours of data for any urgent-level negative mentions. Alert immediately if found.

description.zh: 告诉我关键词和平台，加入监控列表
description.en: Send me a keyword and platforms to track

prompt.zh: 帮我把「XX 品牌」加到舆情监控列表，监控平台：小红书、知乎、微博。
prompt.en: Add 'Brand X' to the sentiment watch list, platforms: xiaohongshu, zhihu, weibo.

description.zh: 生成本周舆情趋势报告，含情感占比、热度趋势、危机事件回顾
description.en: Generate weekly trend report with sentiment ratio, heat trends, crisis recap

prompt.zh: 请生成本周的舆情周报，包括：各平台提及量、正负面占比、热度趋势 TOP5、本周危机事件回顾。
prompt.en: Generate this week's report: mention volume, positive/negative ratio, top-5 heat trends, crisis recap.

zh: 每 2 小时扫描一次监控关键词的各平台搜索结果，负面提及数 ≥ 10 时立即推飞书群告警
每天「09:00」推送昨日舆情日报：提及总量、正负面占比、热度趋势 TOP5、负面摘要
每周一「10:00」生成舆情周报，推送到飞书群
当某关键词负面情感占比超过 60% 且总提及 ≥ 50 时，立即告警并@相关负责人
每天「18:00」扫描竞品关键词，对比我们与竞品的正负面占比差异
en: Every 2 hours scan tracked keywords across platforms; alert Feishu group when negative mentions ≥ 10
Every day at 09:00 push yesterday's sentiment report: total mentions, pos/neg ratio, top-5 trends, negative summary
Every Monday at 10:00 generate weekly sentiment report and push to IM
When a keyword's negative ratio exceeds 60% with ≥ 50 total mentions, alert immediately and @ responsible person
Every day at 18:00 scan competitor keywords and compare our vs competitor positive/negative ratio
